title: Portal 2
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine sikarugir-10.0_6, Highball 0.7.18, macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), 2026-09-02; first verified on macOS 14.6 with Highball 0.7.13, 2026-08-28; shadows checked on an M4, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, DXVK, 2026-10-06: the Relaxation Vault at the start of sp_a1_intro1 has no dynamic shadows with the GPU's own vendor ID and full shadows with the AMD one (same frame, compared side by side)
notes:
Works under DXVK once HDR is off, and the Portal 2 recipe turns it off for you. The story: Source's HDR path triggers a MoltenVK driver bug (a giant zero-attachment render pass aborts the GPU), which made every map load freeze or crash while menus looked fine. With mat_hdr_level 0 (written into portal2/cfg by the recipe, or set Shader Detail to not use HDR in video settings) the intro map runs at 138-147 fps at 1728x1117 on macOS 26.6.2 (DXVK, async off; 210-216 fps was measured on macOS 14.6 with async on). Re-checked on macOS 26.6.2, 2026-09-02: without the recipe (HDR level 2) the intro map load still freezes every time, once as a stuck frame and once as a white screen, with the process left alive; with the recipe two runs stayed live for the full observation. Apply the Portal 2 recipe after installing the game, keep the bottle on DXVK. The same root cause likely affects other Source titles (Portal 1, HL2, TF2, L4D2) and the same fix should transfer. Visual cost: Source's HDR bloom, minor in this game.

Dynamic shadows (sunlight through the blinds, lamps, the shadows furniture and objects cast) are missing with the defaults. Portal 2's renderer only turns on shadow maps when the graphics card reports an NVIDIA, AMD or Intel vendor ID, and the Direct3D 9 every engine uses reports Apple's. The row passes -force_vendor_id 0x1002 -force_device_id 0x73BF on Play, Portal 2's own switch for its GPU identity, so the game takes its AMD path and draws them. Half-Life 2's renderer has the same check, so other Source games probably lose their flashlight and projected shadows the same way; not checked in game yet.

verified.fps: 134 in the main menu, DXVK, HDR-off recipe

knownIssues.symptom: No dynamic shadows. Furniture, objects and characters cast no shadows from lamps or sunlight (reported on an M3 Pro, Discord 2026-10-05)
knownIssues.cause: Portal 2's shaderapidx9.dll sets up shadow depth textures only for vendor IDs 0x10de, 0x1002 and 0x8086 and switches them off for any other. DXVK's Direct3D 9 in the engine reports Apple's vendor ID (0x106b), so the game runs with no shadow maps. Seen on an M4, macOS 27.0, engine r21, DXVK, 2026-10-06.
knownIssues.fix: Highball's Play passes -force_vendor_id 0x1002 -force_device_id 0x73BF (from the next version). By hand, put the same in Portal 2's launch options in Steam.
